exploration_allowance.note: Existing allowance, not a new allocator. No model API calls in the job; session metering unavailable.

outcome_definitions.blocked_access: Attempt stopped at an unresolved access dependency; effort is not zero.
outcome_definitions.blocked_prerequisite: Attempt stopped with missing research prerequisites; no completed dossier claimed.
outcome_definitions.censored_limit: Attempt reached its prospective limit; incomplete right-censored observation.
outcome_definitions.complete: Full attempt through review, corrections and integration; all required evidence checked.
outcome_definitions.incomplete_capability: Available execution cannot perform/measure remaining legal or review work.
outcome_definitions.unsuccessful: Attempt ended without a usable result; effort remains in denominator.

pilot_scope: Offline prerequisite investigation from held claim-kit dossiers and undecided status leads. Full legal production, independent review and complete end-to-end effort remain unavailable.
selection_design: era-status macro strata; SRS joint cells; one SRS order per selected cell
